image_description: A low-angle shot of a pipe organ facade featuring vertical metallic pipes of varying heights arranged in a symmetrical, stepped silhouette. The pipes have a golden/brass reflective finish with decorative finials on top. The organ is mounted against a white wall with wooden side panels and green acoustic padding visible on the far left and right. Above the organ, a wooden ceiling structure with a central decorative wooden element is visible.
